findings.title: Oversized connector file grew further
findings.problem: code-quality.md limits files to 500 lines; this file went from 806 to 898 lines with the endpoint-refresh helpers (readOwnedOtlpEnv, readConfiguredOtlpPort, checkClaudeCodeOtlpEndpoint, refreshClaudeCodeOtlpEndpoint). PROVEN (line count and guide). Disposition: fix before merge.

findings.title: Ticket key in commit subjects
findings.problem: Commits c7471810, 38d1f33c, b6e8d550 end subjects with '(EPMCDME-16647)'; git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says the key belongs in the body footer. PROVEN. Disposition: fix before MR, only on explicit user request for history rewrite (squash-and-merge title may also resolve it).
findings.impact: Documented commit-format convention broken in every commit of the range.
findings.recommendation: Reword subjects without the ticket key and add the key in the commit body footer.
